clue.text: One's incandescent with rage after kind of blue film's opening

indicators.note: after tells us the word for rage is placed behind the other pieces

parts.note: electric blue is a vivid shade of blue

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its first letter, so only the start of the film is used

parts.note: first letter of film
ire is anger

explanation.surface: Someone is white-hot with fury after the start of a blue movie.
explanation.walkthrough: Incandescent suggests furious, but here it is literal: a glowing heater. In Britain an electric fire is a household room heater.
explanation.definitionFit: A domestic heater whose bars glow red-hot is literally incandescent, so it is something that is incandescent.

clue.text: Lamb etc? It's cooked in more than one attempt

indicators.note: cooked food is altered from its raw state, so these letters are rearranged
in places the rearranged letters inside the word for attempts

parts.note: an essay is an attempt; plural for more than one
the letters of its, rearranged

explanation.surface: Lamb is being cooked over several tries in the kitchen.
explanation.walkthrough: Lamb looks like meat, which 'cooked' supports, but it is Charles Lamb, the English essayist of the Essays of Elia.
explanation.definitionFit: Charles Lamb and writers like him composed short prose pieces, making them examples of the category of essay writers.

clue.text: Evacuation of troops in a base to the north

indicators.note: in puts the soldiers inside the other letters
in a down entry, going to the north means reading upwards, from bottom to top

parts.note: taken as written
troops are soldiers or men
e is the base of natural logarithms

explanation.surface: An army pulls its soldiers out of a northern base.
explanation.walkthrough: Evacuation sounds military, but its medical sense is meant: clearing the bowels.
explanation.definitionFit: This procedure flushes out the bowels, and emptying the bowels is called evacuation in medical language.

clue.text: Country bringing down Truss finally shows sense

indicators.note: the letter is then set lower down within the word, so it shows further along
bringing down lifts that letter out of its place in the country word

parts.note: a state is a country

indicators.note: finally points to the final letter of the word before it

parts.note: last letter of Truss

explanation.surface: A nation brought down Liz Truss, the short-lived British prime minister, and so showed good sense.
explanation.walkthrough: The S that opens STATE moves two places lower in the down entry, giving TASTE.
explanation.definitionFit: Taste is one of the five bodily faculties of perception, alongside sight, hearing, smell and touch.

clue.text: Urging group with intelligence to stop camping?

indicators.note: to stop is to plug a gap, so one piece goes into the middle of the other

parts.note: someone camping is in a tent
SIS is the Secret Intelligence Service, Britain's MI6

explanation.surface: Spies are pressing to put an end to camping.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the playful reading of camping as IN TENT.
explanation.definitionFit: Being insistent means pressing or demanding firmly, which is the same as urging someone to do something.

clue.text: Outing competitors with result of drug-taking

parts.note: the field is everyone taking part in a race
a trip is the experience on hallucinogens

explanation.surface: Exposing athletes for doping, with the test results to prove it.
explanation.walkthrough: Outing suggests exposing someone, but it means an excursion.
explanation.definitionFit: A school or study excursion to a site away from the classroom is an educational outing.

clue.text: Corruption keeps cruciverbalists in stir

indicators.note: to keep something is to hold it inside, so one word sits within the other

parts.note: rot is decay or corruption
the setter and solvers, crossword people, are us

explanation.surface: Graft lands crossword compilers in prison, stir being slang for jail.
explanation.walkthrough: Stir looks like the noun for prison, but it is the verb meaning to rouse.
explanation.definitionFit: To roust somebody is to rouse or drive them out of bed or hiding, the same as stirring them.

clue.text: Christian pens old record, a follower of the Way

indicators.note: to pen is to enclose, as sheep in a fold, so the other pieces go inside

parts.note: a Methodist is a Christian of the Wesleyan church
O is a standard abbreviation for old
a log is a written record

explanation.surface: A believer writes an ancient chronicle, as a disciple of the Way, an early name for Christianity.
explanation.walkthrough: The Way sounds like early Christianity, fitting the surface, but here it is simply a way of doing things: a method.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who studies or adheres to systematic procedures follows a method, and a method is a way.

clue.text: Host welcomes different period we live in, a dramatic figure

indicators.note: a host welcomes guests in, so the next word goes inside the host's letters

parts.note: an MC, master of ceremonies, hosts an event
other means different
the period we live in is our age

explanation.surface: A host greets a new era in which we live, like a theatrical personality.
explanation.walkthrough: The host's two letters wrap round the word for different, then the present era follows. The title role in Brecht's play is meant.
explanation.definitionFit: Mother Courage is the canteen-woman heroine of Bertolt Brecht's anti-war play, a famous stage character.

clue.text: Result of check after losing rook

indicators.note: after losing means once something has been taken away from the word

parts.note: to ensure is to check or make certain
R is the chess notation for rook

explanation.surface: A chess check comes about after a rook is lost.
explanation.walkthrough: The chess words check and rook suggest a game, but check is the verb to make sure.
explanation.definitionFit: To ensue is to follow on as a consequence, which is what the verb to result means.

clue.text: Help figure out cryptic instruction for player

indicators.note: cryptic means puzzling or encoded, so the letters must be decoded into another order

parts.note: SOS is the distress call for help
ten is a number, a figure
the letters of out, rearranged

explanation.surface: A plea to help work out a crossword clue for a games player.
explanation.walkthrough: Player sounds like a gamer, but it is a musician.
explanation.definitionFit: Sostenuto is an Italian performance direction in a score telling a musician to sustain the notes.

clue.text: Tourists scrubbing olid farmhands

indicators.note: to scrub is to cancel or rub out, so these letters are removed

parts.note: tourists are holidaymakers
taken as written

explanation.surface: Visitors wash smelly farm workers, olid meaning foul-smelling.
explanation.walkthrough: The rare word olid is chosen only because its letters sit inside the word for tourists.
explanation.definitionFit: Haymakers are workers who cut and dry grass for fodder, so they are labourers on a farm.

clue.text: Day at the start of Long Depression

indicators.note: this places the abbreviation for day in front of the next word

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for day
to long for something is to itch for it

explanation.surface: A day at the beginning of a long period of gloom or economic slump.
explanation.walkthrough: The capitals on Long and Depression make them look like proper names; Long is the verb to yearn.
explanation.definitionFit: A ditch is a trench or channel dug in the ground, which is a physical depression or hollow.

clue.text: Blue fruit around one's drink

indicators.note: around has the fruit surround the remaining pieces

parts.note: a date is a fruit
one is I, and the apostrophe s is is
to sip is to drink a little

explanation.surface: Sad, someone puts fruit round their drink.
explanation.walkthrough: Blue looks like sad, but it is British slang for squander, as in blue your money.
explanation.definitionFit: To dissipate means to fritter away money or resources, and in British slang to blow cash is to blue it.

clue.text: Team contend with quiz

parts.note: Inter Milan is an Italian football team
to vie is to compete
W is an abbreviation for with

explanation.surface: A team competes in a pub quiz.
explanation.definitionFit: To interview someone is to question them closely, and to quiz is also to question.

clue.text: Warning marble bust will break completely

indicators.note: to break into something is to enter it, so one part goes inside the other

parts.note: all means completely

indicators.note: bust means broken, so the letters fall into a new order

parts.note: the letters of marble, rearranged

explanation.surface: A warning that a marble statue's head and shoulders will shatter totally.
explanation.walkthrough: Bust looks like a sculpture, but it is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: An alarm bell rings to alert people to danger, and figuratively it is any sign of trouble ahead.

clue.text: Swear to follow Republican Party regular

indicators.note: to follow places the word for swear after the abbreviation

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for Republican
to aver is to declare or swear

explanation.surface: Swearing loyalty to the Republicans as a faithful party member.
explanation.walkthrough: Party looks political, but it is a festive party.
explanation.definitionFit: A raver is someone who goes out dancing at wild parties and clubs, a habitual partygoer.

clue.text: Model realistic tours fit for tourists

indicators.note: to tour a place is to go round it, so one word goes around the other

parts.note: a viable plan is a realistic one
a model sits or poses for an artist

explanation.surface: A lifelike scale model tours sights suitable for sightseers.
explanation.walkthrough: Tours sits next to tourists, so it reads as part of the same picture, but it is the instruction to wrap.
explanation.definitionFit: A visitable place is open and worth going to see, so it is suitable for sightseers to call on.

clue.text: Incline to listen to virtuoso musician

indicators.note: to listen to means we take the word by ear rather than spelling

parts.note: to list is to lean or incline, as a ship does

explanation.surface: A tilt of the head to hear a brilliant performer.
explanation.definitionFit: Franz Liszt was the dazzling Hungarian pianist and composer of the Romantic era, famed for his technique.

clue.text: Article with advice concerning European food

parts.note: an is an indefinite article
a tip is a piece of advice
as to means concerning

explanation.surface: A magazine piece with recommendations about Continental cuisine.
explanation.definitionFit: Antipasto is the Italian starter of cold meats and pickles, a dish from Italy and so a European dish.

clue.text: This person's toast about drink being knocked back

definitions.note: read as 'this person is toast', describing the person

indicators.note: knocked back means sent backwards, so the letters run in reverse

parts.note: re means about or concerning
nog is a drink, as in eggnog

explanation.surface: Someone raises a toast to a drink they then down in one.
explanation.walkthrough: Toast looks like a celebratory drink, fitting knocked back, but it is slang for done for.
explanation.definitionFit: If someone is toast they are finished or doomed, and a goner is a person beyond saving.

clue.text: Without Anglican affiliation for the time being

parts.note: non- means not or without
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: For now, someone has no ties to the Church of England.
explanation.definitionFit: In the idiom for the nonce, the word means the present occasion, so it equals the time being.

clue.text: One offers drive in car, maintaining current duty

indicators.note: to maintain is to hold or keep, so the car holds the other pieces

parts.note: a motor is a car
I is the symbol for electric current
VAT, value added tax, is a duty in Britain

explanation.surface: A chauffeur offers a ride in a car while keeping up with the latest tax.
explanation.walkthrough: Drive in car suggests motoring, but drive here is ambition or energy.
explanation.definitionFit: A motivator inspires people and gives them energy and ambition, which is what supplying drive means.

clue.text: Adult learner determined to reverse car

indicators.note: to reverse is to go backwards, so all the letters are read the other way

parts.note: A is the film-rating abbreviation for adult
L is the learner-driver plate
set on something is determined

explanation.surface: A grown-up learner driver is resolved to master reversing the car.
explanation.definitionFit: Tesla is the American electric vehicle maker, so one of its models is an example of an automobile.

clue.text: Record of Latin American's capital cut by 50%

indicators.note: cutting by half removes half the letters of the word

parts.note: Montevideo is the capital of Uruguay

explanation.surface: A record of a South American capital's budget slashed in half.
explanation.walkthrough: The ten-letter capital loses its first five letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To video something is to record it on film, and a video is itself a recording of moving pictures.

clue.text: Maybe Egyptian head's fine conditions

parts.note: most Egyptian Muslims are Sunni, so an Egyptian may be one
a ness is a headland

explanation.surface: An Egyptian leader enjoying good weather.
explanation.walkthrough: Head looks like a leader, but it is a promontory, as in Loch Ness or Sheerness.
explanation.definitionFit: Sunniness is the state of being bright and cloudless, which describes fine weather conditions.

clue.text: Prevent eavesdropping in case of dire complaint

indicators.note: a case is the outside covering, so only the outer letters are kept

parts.note: outer letters of dire
a bug is a minor illness

explanation.surface: Stop people listening in when someone has a terrible illness.
explanation.walkthrough: Complaint sounds like a grievance, but it is an ailment.
explanation.definitionFit: To debug a room is to remove hidden microphones, which stops anyone secretly listening in.

clue.text: Much less entertaining setters are going to avoid interfering

indicators.note: to entertain guests is to have them in, so the phrase holds the other piece

parts.note: let alone means much less, as in I can't walk, let alone run
setters say we, and we will contracts to we'll

explanation.surface: Setters plan to keep out of things, which is far less fun.
explanation.walkthrough: Entertaining looks like amusing, but it means taking in.
explanation.definitionFit: To leave something as it is instead of tinkering is to refrain from meddling with it.
